_doc: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and edit there. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored by the loader. Relative paths resolve against the project root.

server._doc: Default bind is loopback only. --host 0.0.0.0 enables LAN access for UI testing (DEC-21).

browser._doc: mode: 'attach' (default; app starts normal Chrome with a debug port, Selenium attaches) or 'launch' (Selenium starts Chrome). chrome_binary null = auto-detect. chromedriver_path null = Selenium Manager downloads the matching ChromeDriver; set it to a chromedriver(.exe) you downloaded if that fails (offline, proxy). Never point profile_dir at your everyday Chrome profile.

retries._doc: step_* = retry of one UI step; part_auto_retries = automatic retries of a whole part within a run (ER2/ER5 only); consecutive failures pause the job (DEC-12).

limits._doc: max_reference_images_per_part and max_script_chars come from M1 findings (DEC-01, DEC-04): Vids accepted 2 images and showed no prompt limit up to 6000 characters. null = no check.

naming._doc: Python str.format templates. Tokens: {project} {part} {title}. Clip template must contain {part} (DEC-05).

fake._doc: enabled=true or --fake uses FakeVidsController (no Google access). --scenario overrides scenario.
